name: Cougar Lane Lodge & RV
note: Lodge, store and RV park above the Rogue River at Agness, 4219 Agness Rd, also the Rogue jet-boat lunch stop; cabins, lodge rooms, RV and tent sites. RV sites $44.84 (30A) or $50.22 (50A) a night in Oct 2026; 2027 not yet open for booking, so check summer rates. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: AWH read the operator's ResNexus engine 2026-10-05: Oct 2026 RV sites $44.84 30A / $50.22 50A; Good Sam 8.3, Google 4.5 over 127 with phone; satellite 2026-10-05 shows RV pads south of the lodge

lead.wf_evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 42.5586,-124.0569: lodge and RV pads on a terrace above the Rogue; the river's gravel bar and channel lie ~150-200 m west beyond trees; no pad at the waterline; not waterfront

name: Deschutes River Fly Shop & Camp
note: 36-site RV park and campground with a fly shop at 7228 US-26 on the lower Deschutes near Warm Springs: premium sites with full hookups (30/50A), others with power and water (some with sewer); pull-through, back-in and head-in sites. Nightly and weekly April-October (summer from $35, 2026), month-to-month November-April. Book online. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: operator site (read 2026-10-05): 36 sites, 30/50A, nightly Apr-Oct, Firefly booking; AWH read the engine 2026-10-05: summer sites from $35; Google 4.8 over 102 with phone; satellite 2026-10-05 shows the gravel RV loops east of US-26

lead.wf_evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 44.7408,-121.2281: gravel RV loops among junipers east of US-26; the Deschutes is ~250 m west across the highway; not waterfront

name: Robinson Campground (Pine Creek Conservation Area)
note: CLOSED until further notice after the July 2026 fires (posted 2026-07-28: fire hazards incl. falling trees). Primitive Confederated Tribes of Warm Springs campground on the Pine Creek Conservation Area off OR-218 near milepost 33, 9.5 mi east of the John Day River bridge at Clarno and 10 mi west of Fossil: tent, car and RV camping, pit toilets, no water or hookups; behind a locked gate, reservation required (online, lands.warmsprings-nsn.gov). Max 8 people / 2 vehicles per site. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: CTWS Conservation Lands pages (read 2026-10-05): reservable primitive campground for tent, car or RV behind a reservation-only gate; closed 2026-07-28 for fire damage, added as a temporary closure per AWH 2026-10-05; satellite 2026-10-05 shows open gravel pull-ins along a loop road beside the creek; site count and lengths unpublished

lead.wf_evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 44.8993,-120.2905: gravel loop road and pull-ins in open grassland; the creek runs ~50 m east behind a riparian strip; no pad provably at the water; not waterfront
